text:
Jordan: Quick post-all-hands follow-up on the reliability segment. RCA is live: https://redwood.in/rca/204000. Sharing concise asks and owners here.
Priya: Can someone drop a one-liner timeline for execs? the doc is dense.
Sam: Timeline: 04:02 alert, 04:10 partial mitigation (fallback routing), 04:28 targeted cache bump, 04:40 full recovery. Root cause: eviction amplification from a rare request mix + shard hot-spotting.
Mei: Infra note added to RCA about placement policy contributing to hotspot. Short-term: targeted cache bump + routing fallback. Medium-term: permanent rebalance + eviction fix.
Ravi: I can do the targeted cache-bump automation + rollback guardrail. Will add infra flag + metric. ETA: 3 business days.
Taylor: I'll draft the customer note and an internal support FAQ. Suggest: 2 bullets + link to RCA. ETA: tomorrow AM.
Luis: Leadership asked for an SLO-triggered policy spec (when do we fallback vs. failover?). I can draft decision criteria with cost/impact bullets.
Dana: I'll help map those criteria to observability signals. Sam/Mei can you list the exact metrics we should use?
Sam: Key signals: KV cache pressure (p95/p99), hot-shard eviction rate, request shape frequency. I'll post metric names to the RCA.
OpsBot: incident:204000 acknowledged 04:02, mitigated 04:28, recovered 04:40. RCA: https://redwood.in/rca/204000
Jordan: Action items (owners + due dates):
```
- R1: Cache-bump automation + guardrails (Ravi) - 3bd
- R2: SLO-trigger policy draft (Luis + Dana) - 5bd
- R3: Exec one-paragraph summary (Jordan) - 1bd
- R4: Customer comms + support FAQ (Taylor) - 1bd
- R5: Shard rebalance RFC (Mei) - next sprint
- R6: Add KV cache pressure metric + alerts (Ravi + Dana) - 2w
- R7: CI replay test for repro request shapes (Sam) - 2w
```
Priya: Please state whether the cache metric should be on all nodes or GPU-only.
Ravi: Prefer all nodes for visibility; will tag metrics with host_role.
Dana: Agreed. Also proposal: auto-fallback should cap at 10% of traffic to limit latency impact. Will add to draft.
Luis: I'll include cost delta estimates for fallback vs cross-region failover in the decision doc.
Taylor: Comm note will include a 3-bullet customer-friendly timeline and link.
Jordan: Thanks all. Please ack here and post short progress updates so we can close these in the all-hands tracker. If you need help, ping @oncall or flag in #eng-oncall.
Sam: Acked R7 and will upload replay scripts soon.
Mei: Acked R5, opening RFC today.
Ravi: Acked R1/R6. Starting instrumentation work.
Taylor: Acked R4. Draft incoming tomorrow AM.
Luis: Acked R2. Drafting decision criteria.
Dana: Acked. I'll sync with Sam on metric names.
Jordan: Closing note: leadership wants a 2-sentence summary for the next exec sync; I'll pull from Luis' draft. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
